note: The four topic areas from the redesign. Tag matching is case-insensitive, because tags are typed by hand and the content already mixes 'Kingdom' with 'kingdom'. Each maps to the tags a piece can carry. A topic only appears on a section page once at least one published piece actually carries one of its tags, so the sidebar never promises a reader a room with nothing in it. Add the tag to a post in the editor and the topic turns itself on.
